THE REGFIRE SUITE

One event.
More ways to ignite it.

One connected suite: make complex event work easier through conversation. Explore our registration, lead capture, print, onsite, and event-management products.

The RegFire suite

RegFire

RegFire brings event setup, registration choices and attendee previews into one workspace. Built for organizers of small gatherings through major trade shows, it helps shape questions, attendee types, pricing and confirmations around your event. Our focus is a clearer attendee journey and less coordination work for the team behind it.

Explore RegFire ↗
The RegFire suite

LeadFire

LeadFire is our lead capture product for exhibitors and event teams. It connects contact details with the context of each conversation: interests, notes and follow-up priorities. It helps teams leave the show floor with organized opportunities and a clear next step.

Explore LeadFire ↗
The RegFire suite

Ignite Print Solutions

Ignite Print Solutions focuses on the physical pieces that bring an event to life. From directional signage and branded displays to useful handouts, we deliver coordinated print that looks professional and serves a purpose. Share your event concept, audience and venue requirements to start planning the right materials.

Explore Ignite Print Solutions ↗
Onsite services

Blaze

Blaze — Onsite. Fast. Bold. brings onsite registration, badge printing, session attendance, CEU tracking, access control and item fulfillment into one connected event experience. It helps teams welcome attendees and coordinate the event floor, with practical workflows that keep staff focused on helping people move forward.

Explore Blaze ↗
The RegFire suite

Groundswell Event Management

Groundswell Event Management focuses on bringing the whole event together, from early planning through onsite execution. For organizers balancing schedules, people and operational details, the approach connects responsibilities with a clear plan. The result is fewer loose ends and a coordinated team that understands what needs to happen next.

ABOUT US

Registration is more
than a form.
It’s your first impression.

RegFire brings together three founders, each with over 25 years of experience across technology, trade shows, and customer service in the event industry. That experience shapes how we build: around the people organizing events and the attendees they serve.

Our conversational AI puts organizers in control. Describe the registration experience you need, refine the details through conversation, and review the result. Our approach is grounded in real event workflows.

Our mission

To build the easiest way to create and manage registration for events—staying at the forefront of AI and combining its latest advances with thoughtful design and outstanding service so organizers can accomplish more with less effort. We measure success by the experience we create for our customers and the people who make it possible.

Our core values

Make complex feel simple.

Every feature should remove effort, confusion, or unnecessary steps. Ease of use is our responsibility.

Stay curious. Build what matters.

Keep moving with technology. Put AI to work where it makes life easier, while keeping people informed and in control.

Make service personal.

Listen carefully, respond thoughtfully, and follow through. Behind every event is a person counting on us.

Care starts within.

Our employees deserve the same respect, attention, and support we promise our customers. Great service begins with how we treat each other.

Earn trust every day.

Protect the information entrusted to us. Be honest about our capabilities, own our mistakes, and keep our commitments.

Build with the people who use it.

Let real conversations shape the product. Keep improving until the experience feels natural.

Work with passion.

Bring energy, initiative, and pride to everything we do. RegFire was built on a strong work ethic: take ownership, follow through, and care about getting the details right. Turn that commitment into work we are proud of and service people can count on.
